description: Intelligent Energy Systems Ontology: Local flexibility market and power system co-simulation demonstration is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Gabriel Santos, Hugo Morais (GECAD - ISEP/IPP). The Intelligent Energy Systems Ontology (IESO) provides semantic interoperability within a society of multi-agent systems (MAS) developed in the scope of power and energy systems (PES). Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
